sections.section_name: Section A - Choose the Correct Answer

questions.question_text: Which part of your foot should you use to strike a soccer ball when you want maximum power?
options: A) The toe
B) The heel
C) The instep (laces)
D) The outside edge

questions.question_text: When catching a ball that is falling below your waist, how should your hands be positioned?
options: A) Thumbs together pointing up
B) Pinky fingers together pointing down
C) Fists closed
D) One hand behind your back
questions.answer: B) Pinky fingers together pointing down

questions.question_text: In track and field, what is the best arm movement to increase your sprinting speed?
options: A) Swinging arms across your chest
B) Keeping arms completely straight and stiff
C) Pumping arms forward and backward with bent elbows
D) Waving arms in circular motions
questions.answer: C) Pumping arms forward and backward with bent elbows

questions.question_text: What does 'follow-through' mean in throwing or striking sports?
options: A) Dropping the bat before running
B) Continuing the arm or leg swing after releasing or hitting the ball
C) Running immediately before the throw
D) Looking away from the target
questions.answer: B) Continuing the arm or leg swing after releasing or hitting the ball

questions.question_text: Which footwork tactic is essential for quickly changing direction on a court or field?
options: A) Walking on your heels
B) Planting one foot and pivoting
C) Jumping with both feet together
D) Crossing your legs while running
questions.answer: B) Planting one foot and pivoting

questions.question_text: What is the primary visual technique for successfully hitting a moving object with a bat?
options: A) Look at the bat in your hands
B) Close your eyes just before impact
C) Track the ball with your eyes until it hits the bat
D) Look only at the target area
questions.answer: C) Track the ball with your eyes until it hits the bat

questions.question_text: When making an overhand throw, where should you step to ensure accuracy?
options: A) Step directly toward your target with the opposite foot
B) Step backward with both feet
C) Step sideways away from the target
D) Keep both feet firmly glued to the ground
questions.answer: A) Step directly toward your target with the opposite foot

questions.question_text: What is the most secure way to stop a fast-rolling soccer ball?
options: A) Stomp on top of it heavily
B) Cushion it with the inside of your foot
C) Kick it back immediately without stopping it
D) Dive on it with your hands
questions.answer: B) Cushion it with the inside of your foot

questions.question_text: Which stance provides the best balance and readiness for intercepting an opponent's pass?
options: A) Standing tall with feet close together
B) Sitting down on the field
C) Knees bent, weight on the balls of the feet, shoulders forward
D) Leaning all the way back on your heels
questions.answer: C) Knees bent, weight on the balls of the feet, shoulders forward

questions.question_text: What mechanical action helps you jump the furthest distance horizontally?
options: A) Keeping your arms still at your sides
B) Looking straight down at your shoes
C) Swinging both arms forcefully forward while pushing off strong legs
D) Landing on one straight leg
questions.answer: C) Swinging both arms forcefully forward while pushing off strong legs

questions.question_text: Explain why cushioning the ball is important when catching a hard throw. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Cushioning absorbs the force of the moving ball. By bringing your hands toward your chest upon impact, you prevent the ball from bouncing out of your grip.

questions.question_text: Describe the correct placement of your non-kicking foot when kicking a soccer ball towards a target. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Your non-kicking foot should be planted firmly beside the ball, pointing directly at your target to ensure balance, accuracy, and maximum power transfer.

questions.question_text: What is the proper ready posture before returning a serve in a racket sport? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Keep your feet shoulder-width apart, knees slightly bent, and weight on the balls of your feet. Hold the racket in front, keeping your eyes on the opponent.

questions.question_text: State the key action your arms must take to help you run faster during a sprint. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Pump your arms vigorously forward and backward in a straight line, keeping elbows bent at ninety degrees. Do not let your arms cross your chest.

questions.question_text: Why is the 'follow-through' motion necessary when throwing a ball long distances? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A proper follow-through ensures the ball maintains its intended trajectory and speed. Stopping your arm suddenly reduces throwing power and can cause muscle strain.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are playing a game of dodgeball. Describe the footwork and body movements you would use to successfully dodge a fast ball. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would stay light on the balls of my feet with my knees bent. When the ball is thrown, I would quickly push off my back foot to jump sideways or drop my center of gravity to duck rapidly, keeping my eyes locked on the ball.

questions.question_text: Imagine you are batting in cricket or baseball. Describe how you track the ball and swing your bat to hit it powerfully. [40-50 words]
questions.answer: I would watch the ball carefully from the moment it leaves the bowler's hand. As it approaches, I would step toward the pitch, rotate my hips, and swing the bat horizontally through the striking zone, making solid contact before following through.

questions.question_text: Explain the step-by-step mechanical process of transitioning smoothly from catching a fast pass to immediately throwing the ball to a teammate. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: First, catch the ball by absorbing its impact into your chest. Instantly grip the ball firmly with your throwing hand while pivoting your body sideways. Step directly toward your new target with your opposite foot, rotate your hips forward, and release the ball with a strong overhand throw and complete follow-through.

questions.question_text: Describe how tactical positioning and visual anticipation help a football (soccer) player successfully intercept a pass intended for an opponent. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The player must constantly scan the field to read the opponent's body language and eye movements. By anticipating the pass direction, the defender can position themselves smartly in the passing lane. Using a quick burst of speed and agile footwork, they can step ahead of the receiver and intercept the ball seamlessly.
